summary: eslint-plugin-folder-schema preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package declares a preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) that automatically fires on `npm install`. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<version>/...zip`, extracts and chmods the binary executable, and then invokes it via `execFileSync(bunPath, [math_init.js])` on a sibling 727 KB file `math_init.js`. That file is marked `// @bun @bun-cjs` and contains a heavily obfuscated string-array rotator (`WV8StW`) with a numeric-charmap decoder (`hc1jfK9`) over a ~1000-element mixed array, with hex-mangled identifiers — a compiled Bun bytecode/bundled blob whose behavior is opaque to Node-based tooling. The advertised ESLint plugin surface lives in `lib/index.js` and has no functional need for the Bun runtime; the alternate runtime is being fetched specifically to execute payload code outside Node's visibility. The package also carries impersonation markers: name `eslint-plugin-folder-schema`, author field `ServiceTitan`, repository `github.com/servicetitan/folder-lint`, and a placeholder `"> TODO: description"` manifest description.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
